install.description: Builds a SwiftPM executable product in release, signs a copy under the Apple Development identity with the hardened runtime, and renames it over ~/.local/bin/<product>, the per-user folder launchd's PATH holds

package.description: Archives each app with its xcodebuild invocation and builds each SwiftPM executable product in release, signing each product under the Apple Development identity with the hardened runtime, then zips each under its bundle or product name with ditto; where ASC_API_KEY_P8, ASC_API_KEY_ID, and ASC_API_ISSUER_ID are set, exports each archive under the Developer ID Application identity into a disk image in place of the zip, signs it, notarizes it with that App Store Connect key, and staples the ticket, and signs each product under that identity with a secure timestamp and notarizes its zip

run.description: Runs swift and xcodebuild invocations in order with Nx's per-task environment removed and git status.branch off after the caller's GIT_CONFIG_<n> entries, stopping at the first failure

upgrade.description: Moves the lower bound of each remote requirement of Package.swift whose range ends at the next major, the range from: states, to the highest semver tag git ls-remote lists for its repository, prereleases included, among the tags published at or after the bound's own tag, as SwiftPM admits a prerelease only into a range with a prerelease bound, then moves Package.resolved with swift package update

release-publish.description: Signs a Sparkle feed for the disk images beside each archive among the files the target's dependentTasksOutputFiles input matches in the outputs of the tasks it depends on with generate_appcast under the key SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY holds, pointing at the image's asset on the GitHub release of the project's tag at the checked-out commit, the tag nx release made from the release tag pattern of the project's release group, and uploads it to the R2 bucket SPARKLE_FEED_BUCKET names at the path of the app's SUFeedURL with cf r2 objects put, fails naming those outputs where they hold no matching file, and where an archive has no disk image beside it, either variable is unset, or nx release released no version of the project at that commit names what is missing and publishes nothing; runs through nx release publish, a dry run previewing every project
